Reasoning: Directly count non-hydrogen bonds according to the specified method. Ph represents phenyl, and there are 6 C-C bonds inside the benzene ring; there is 1 bond from Ph to the central carbon; there is 1 bond from the central carbon to the CH3 carbon; there is 1 bond from the central carbon to O; there is 1 bond from O to Zn; there is 1 bond from Zn to Cl. raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First inspect the image and ignore all curved arrows and the H labels. Count non-hydrogen bonds directly: the phenyl ring contributes 6 C-C bonds; the bond from Ph to the central carbon contributes 1; the central carbon to the CH3 carbon contributes 1; the central carbon to O contributes 1; O-Zn contributes 1; Zn-Cl contributes 1. Do not count the lower Cl- as bonded because it is shown as a separate component. Sum 6+1+1+1+1+1 = 11.

推理：按指定方法直接计数非氢键。Ph代表苯基，苯环内部有6个C-C键；Ph到中心碳有1个键；中心碳到CH3碳有1个键；中心碳到O有1个键；O到Zn有1个键；Zn到Cl有1个键。下方Cl⁻是单独组分，没有画成与中心结构成键，因此不计入。总数为6+1+1+1+1+1=11。
